threat_event: Card-capturing malware spreads to hotel and park POS through the shared legacy POS vendor's remote support
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Same legacy integrated POS at 23 hotels and 2 Florida theme parks; vendor always-on remote tool outside PAM; no EDR on POS servers; clear text card data in POS memory
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H3 legacy POS; SYS-A2 legacy kiosks; PMPS
existing_controls: P2PE at most outlets; segment monitoring; quarterly scans; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: Vendor access through PAM with named accounts by 2026-12-31; compensating monitoring on legacy segments; finish P2PE replacement by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Guest profile hub data, including owners' bank account numbers, is read in bulk through an over-broad integration credential
threat_source: External attacker with a stolen service credential; insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CRS integration service account can read every hub table; key not rotated since 2024; payment preferences table holds full bank and routing numbers for about 212,000 owners
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; SOC monitoring of the hub; MFA for administrators
treatment_plan: Restrict the service account to loyalty fields; rotate keys every 90 days; remove bank data from the hub and keep it tokenized in SYS-V3

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses an FTC, card brand, owner, state, or SEC deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Multi-regulator notification matrix never exercised; FTC Safeguards Rule notice not in the Vacation Ownership plan
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: AI systems set prices or credit terms without adequate governance, producing unlawful or harmful outcomes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 AI use cases, 6 reviewed by the AI council; emergency pricing, fee display, adverse action reasons, and decision records not controlled
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H5; SYS-A1 pricing; SYS-V2 credit model; SYS-V4
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10): review all use cases; conditions on AI-001, AI-002, AI-006, AI-007
related_risk_ids: HTL-15; HTL-16; HTL-17; ATT-10; ATT-14; VO-06; VO-07; VO-11

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared identity and network services into several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, SD-WAN, and hubs connect all divisions; Vacation Ownership legacy directory and data center outside group PAM and EDR coverage
treatment_plan: Move Vacation Ownership to SYS-G1 and group EDR; segment the legacy data center; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: A breach of loan and owner data in the acquired division exposes the group to FTC Safeguards Rule enforcement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vacation Ownership outside group common controls: no MFA for 340 users; unencrypted loan document archive; 12 of 31 service providers unassessed
existing_controls: Qualified Individual designated; written risk assessment
treatment_plan: Safeguards Rule remediation plan approved by the finance subsidiary board; Qualified Individual reports progress monthly
owner: Vacation Ownership security and compliance lead

threat_event: Division staff follow outdated standards that conflict with group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vacation Ownership follows its 2023 standards; inheritance not documented; Attractions supplement silent on ride control
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Vacation Ownership supplement; document inheritance; annual attestation

threat_event: A critical SaaS provider (PMS, ticketing, contact center) suffers an outage or breach affecting a division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single PMS vendor for 88 hotels; single ticketing vendor for 7 parks
existing_controls: Annual AOC and SOC report reviews; downtime procedures
treatment_plan: Contracted recovery objectives for all tier 1 vendors; quarterly vendor risk review

threat_event: An attacker reaches ride and show control from the park business network and affects a ride
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor maintenance jump host bridges the business and ride control networks at 2 parks
existing_controls: Fail-safe ride design; engineering verification before opening
treatment_plan: Remove the jump host bridge; one-way maintenance path with PAM and engineering approval
owner: Attractions vice president of ride engineering

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over loyalty and owner accounts across the shared guest identity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Optional member MFA (27% adoption); one account across hotels, parks, and owner portal
treatment_plan: Step-up MFA for redemptions and payment changes; MFA required for owners

threat_event: The disclosure committee misjudges materiality of a cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality playbook not exercised for owner-merchant or Vacation Ownership incidents
treatment_plan: Add cross-division scenarios to the playbook; include in the 2026-12 tabletop

threat_event: Attack activity goes undetected in systems outside SIEM coverage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy POS servers and the Vacation Ownership legacy data center not onboarded to SYS-G2
treatment_plan: Onboard remaining sources; compensating network detection at legacy segments

threat_event: Hotel and park guest data is used for vacation ownership marketing in ways the privacy notices do not disclose
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tour marketing draws leads from SYS-G5; notices do not clearly describe cross-division sharing
treatment_plan: Revise notices; purpose tags on lead feeds; honor opt-outs across divisions

threat_event: Indefinitely retained guest profiles enlarge the impact of any breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 52 million profiles kept indefinitely, about 7.9 million with identity document numbers
treatment_plan: Retention schedule: delete ID numbers 30 days after checkout; inactive profiles after 5 years

threat_event: A major hurricane closes Florida hotels, parks, and the headquarters for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration at the Florida destination resort and headquarters
existing_controls: Crisis plan; Cloud provider B recovery; remote work
treatment_plan: Annual hurricane exercise with IT recovery; alternate command center outside Florida

threat_event: A privileged administrator misuses access to shared services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad administrator rights in shared services
existing_controls: JIT PAM with session recording; separation of duties
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Group CISO; PAM controls reviewed annually

threat_event: Group payment services fail and halt card channels in every division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One tokenization and vault service for all divisions
existing_controls: Active standby region; P2PE terminals authorize directly
treatment_plan: Twice-yearly regional failover test; documented manual fallbacks per channel
owner: Group Director of Payments and PCI Compliance

threat_event: Owners dispute responsibility for a breach at a managed hotel because agreements are silent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 of 58 management agreements signed before 2020 lack security and incident notice terms; responsibility matrix not given to all owners
treatment_plan: Security and incident notice addendum offered to all owners; matrix and AOC to every owner
